introduction:
A Caste Certificate (also called a Community Certificate) is an official document issued by the Maharashtra Government that certifies a person's Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Vimukta Jati (VJ), Nomadic Tribe (NT), Special Backward Class (SBC), or Other Backward Class (OBC) status.

This guide provides a comprehensive step-by-step walkthrough for citizens and Common Service Center (CSC) operators on how to register and apply online via the Aaple Sarkar portal or offline at local offices.
quickFacts:
Important to Know
  • Purpose & Portal: Step-by-step guide for applying for a Caste Certificate via Maharashtra's Aaple Sarkar (MahaOnline) portal.
  • Target Audience: Citizens of Maharashtra and CSC VLEs / Maha e-Seva Kendra operators.
  • Application Fee: ₹128 (deducted from VLE wallet for online processing).
  • File Specifications: All uploaded documents must be under 500 KB in size.
  • New Format Note: Newly generated caste certificates often feature a combined format including caste, residence, and income/non-creamy layer details on a single document.
documentsRequired:
Documents Required

Note: Compile these original and self-attested photocopies before initiating the application process.
Identity & Address Proofs
  • Identity Proof: Aadhaar Card of the Applicant and Beneficiary.
  • Address Proof (Any one): Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, or Ration Card.
  • Photograph: A passport-sized photo (or a live photo captured via webcam during the online process).
Primary Caste & Education Proofs
  • Old Family Caste Proofs: Old family caste proofs (such as "C-Form" / क-पत्रक 1958 document, or older proofs based on category cut-off dates).
  • Vamshaval (वंशावळ): Family Tree Affidavit explaining the exact relationship between the applicant and the relative whose caste proof is being used.
  • Educational Proofs (Beneficiary): School Leaving Certificate (Nirgam Utara / TC) or Bonafide Certificate showing caste entry.
Blood Relative Proofs & Affidavits
  • Relative Documents: Father's Aadhaar Card, School Leaving Certificate (TC), Nirgam Utara, Address proof, and old Caste Certificate (if available).
  • Affidavit (Self-declaration): Mandatory for OBC, VJNT, and SBC categories. Generally not required for SC/ST categories.
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Apply Online via Aaple Sarkar VLE Portal

Follow this process to apply online through the Aaple Sarkar VLE / Maha e-Seva portal:

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Login: Log in to the Aaple Sarkar portal using your CSC VLE ID and password.
  2. Search Service: Type "Caste" in the search bar on the dashboard and select the certificate type you need (e.g., "Caste VJNT Certificate"). Choose the English version and click Continue.
  3. Applicant Details: Enter the applicant's salutation, full name (English and Marathi), Father's name, Date of Birth, Age, Gender, Mobile number, and complete address (District, Taluka, Village, Pincode, and Occupation).
  4. Beneficiary Relation: Select the relation of the beneficiary to the applicant (e.g., Self, Son, Daughter).
  5. Beneficiary Details: Enter the beneficiary's name, Date of Birth, Gender, and specify if their permanent address matches the applicant's (Yes/No).
  6. Education Details: Enter the beneficiary's educational history (e.g., SSC, HSC), including Board/University, Start Year, End Year, and Institute details. Click Add for each qualification.
  7. Birth Details: Enter the District, Taluka, and Village of birth for the beneficiary.
  8. Caste/Category Details: Select the exact Caste from the dropdown menu (the Category will auto-populate). Select the Religion (e.g., Hindu).
  9. Other Details: Provide the reason for requesting the certificate (e.g., "Education Purpose"). Choose whether an Affidavit is needed (select "Yes" for OBC/VJNT/SBC; "No" for SC/ST).
  10. Agreement: Read the declaration, check the "I accept" box, and click Proceed.
  11. Upload Documents: Click on "Click here to Upload Document". Select the Document Type, choose the file (Max 500 KB), and click Add Document. Repeat until all required proofs are added, then click Continue.
  12. Upload Photograph: Capture a live photo of the applicant using a webcam or upload a standard photo, then click Proceed.
  13. Payment: Click on Pay Now and process the payment (₹128) through the VLE wallet.
  14. Receipt: After successful payment, print or save the generated Acknowledgement Receipt to track the application.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Apply Offline at Tahsildar / SDO Office

To submit a paper application for a caste certificate in Maharashtra, follow these steps:

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Visit Local Office: Go to the nearest Tahsildar Office, Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO), or a registered Setu Kendra / Maha e-Seva Kendra in your taluka.
  2. Obtain Form: Request a "Caste Certificate Application Form" (Form A-1).
  3. Fill Form: Fill out all personal, educational, and family details accurately using a blue or black pen.
  4. Affidavit: Procure a self-declaration affidavit on a ₹100 stamp paper (notarized), declaring your caste, religion, and family tree.
  5. Attach Documents: Attach clear photocopies of all the required documents listed in the documents checklist above.
  6. Submission: Submit the completed form along with the documents and pay the nominal processing fee to the designated desk officer.
  7. Collect Receipt: Save the acknowledgment receipt with your application number, which is required to collect your physical certificate (issued within 15 to 30 working days).
afterApplying:
After Applying — What Next?

Track Status

On the Aaple Sarkar dashboard, click on eDistrict Status. Select your date range, choose the status filter (Pending, Approved, or Rejected), and click Display Applications.

View Progress

Review the application list to see the current processing status and the administrative desk currently handling your file.

Download Certificate

Once the status changes to Approved, click on the Application ID to download the digitally signed PDF of the Caste Certificate. You can then print the certificate directly.
